lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines of varying thickness; spacing is significantly wider at the anterior shoulder (approx. 50-70 pixels) and narrows to denser spacing (approx. 20-30 pixels) towards the mid-torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified on the 11th vertical stripe (counted anterior to posterior) near the dorsal-most terminus, where the line splits into a Y-shaped topology.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 1 and Stripe 12 are significantly abbreviated, terminating mid-torso; multiple dashed line fragments are present in the lower ventral region of the mid-torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular spots positioned on the lateral posterior haunch, with a third smaller spot located approximately 30 pixels ventral to the primary pair.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark located between the orbital regions; prominent white patch on the lower cervical/throat region; white banding visible on the carpal and tarsal joints.
